title: Throes of Contagion
summary: Prepare and plant three toxins, then escape before the poison fills Thundercrest.
overview: Prepare and plant three toxins, then escape before the poison fills Thundercrest.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Check the next ingredient before advancing and begin the exit run as soon as the final toxin is placed.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Each placement requires its corresponding toxin on the interacting player and consumes it.
The first two placements create the next component corpse.
Planting the third starts a twenty-minute evacuation timer.
If time expires, the task ends and Poison Cloud repeatedly strikes clients and their pets.
